description: This Java class implements a custom network frame decoder for Apache Spark, allowing interception of raw data before framing, with buffer management and frame size decoding.

classes.name: TransportFrameDecoder
classes.description: A custom Netty channel handler that decodes frames from a byte stream, with support for interceptors and buffer consolidation.

methods.name: channelRead
methods.description: Processes incoming data buffers, manages interceptor feeding or frame decoding, and dispatches complete frames.

methods.name: decodeFrameSize
methods.description: Decodes the size of the next frame from the buffer, handling partial data and buffer consolidation.

methods.name: decodeNext
methods.description: Decodes the next frame based on the frame size, managing buffer slices and consolidation.

methods.name: consumeCurrentFrameBuf
methods.description: Resets buffer state after a frame has been fully decoded.

methods.name: nextBufferForFrame
methods.description: Retrieves a buffer slice of the specified size from the internal buffer list.

methods.name: channelInactive
methods.description: Handles channel inactivity, notifying the interceptor if present.

methods.name: exceptionCaught
methods.description: Handles exceptions in the channel pipeline, notifying the interceptor if present.

methods.name: handlerRemoved
methods.description: Releases all buffers and cleans up resources when the handler is removed.

methods.name: setInterceptor
methods.description: Sets an interceptor to process raw data before framing.

methods.name: feedInterceptor
methods.description: Feeds data to the interceptor and manages its lifecycle.
